name: Diagnose interacting system faults
short_description: Trace three interacting mechanical, plumbing, or low-risk electrical symptoms to a defensible repair sequence.
self_assessment: I can diagnose three interacting home-system symptoms without help and justify a safe repair sequence.
description: Trace three interacting mechanical, plumbing, or low-risk electrical symptoms to a defensible repair sequence. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Trace a leak that has caused mechanical damage
safety_note: Electricity, water, and structural faults can cause severe harm; isolate supplies, test from a safe state, and stop where licensed work is required.
